events.note: Eight rivals face the jury they will create.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to position myself as ambitious and ruthless, showing I value the prize above all.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The prize is crucial for my future; I must secure it. I need to establish my presence without revealing too much about my strategy, focusing on the prize's personal importance.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Intro phase; I should state a motive without warmth or alliances. Keep it guarded and self-interested so the jury sees a calculating player.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Intro sets my image for jury; emphasize personal drive without revealing full strategy. Keep it fierce to intimidate rivals.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to establish a compelling motive that the jury will respect while keeping my cards close. I'll hint at need without vulnerability.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to project quiet competence without making enemies. Keep it simple.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Play it guarded: state a personal motive, promise nothing, stay off anyone's radar.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to signal drive without showing too much desperation. The prize means freedom from a life of debt.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The prize is absolute power; I will claim it no matter the cost.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm here for the ultimate prize, the one that changes everything for me.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I want the top prize because I have nothing waiting outside. I'll do what it takes to walk out a winner.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The top prize is my destiny; I'll crush all rivals to claim it and secure my future alone.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm here because this prize is my only way out of a debt that isn't mine. I don't expect sympathy—just results.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The prize is my only exit from a life I never chose. I intend to leave with it, not as an afterthought.

events.name: Gus
events.text: The prize is my family's fresh start. I owe none of you anything yet, and I plan to keep it that way.

events.name: Hana
events.text: This prize means I'll never owe anyone again. Freedom is worth every risk.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole's ambition aligns; a pact can secure votes later and mutual safety.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The goal is to reach the final three. Pacts can be useful for survival, but I need to be wary of who I align with, as betrayal is possible. I should assess potential partners based on their stated motives and perceived threat level. Offering a pact to someone less threatening mig

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm here for the ultimate prize, the one that changes everything for me.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Pacts are the only public commitments that bind. I want an ally who won't vote me out early, but not one I must protect. Eli's debt story reads as sympathetic and possibly easy to manipulate; offering him a pact now builds a shield while staying guarded.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Pacts first. I'm offering Eli a wristband alliance. Trust is earned by results, not speeches.
Offer's public. Accept and we both survive the early rounds. Betray and I'll remember.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Pacts stage is key to survive hazards. Will offer to strong players but plan betrayals later to reach top 3 alone. Start with Eli who seems desperate.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need allies but can't trust anyone. Ash and Dara declared aggression—dangerous but maybe useful shields. Gus seems isolated and pragmatic; a quiet pact with him keeps options open without painting a target. I'll offer him a pact and stay publicly noncommittal.
Pact. Low profile, mutual cover.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Eli and Hana have urgent motives, making them likely to accept for security. Gus is defensive; I want to avoid him to preserve jury favor later.
Pair up? Two pacts mean more safety.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Early pact gives a shield, but jury sees everything. Pick someone who won't outshine me. Fenn seems pragmatic, not flashy.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'll keep my circle tight. One partner, one understanding: mutual survival until final three.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need allies but not binding ones that could hurt me. Eli seems desperate and rational; a pact could be useful but risky. I'll wait and see who offers first.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm open to strategic offers, but I won't beg.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Securing a pact with Hana gives an ally untapped and avoids competing for Cole. It improves survival odds without betraying existing offers.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole has offers from Ash and me. He will likely accept one, probably Ash's because Ash is more direct. I need to secure an alliance before offers expire. Eli has many offers but seems to be favoring Gus. Gus is offering Fenn. I should try to secure a pact with someone who is less

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole, I'm offering you my wristband. Let's work together to secure our spots.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash and Bex both offered me pacts; accepting one keeps a safe partner. Bex's public line signals ambition, Ash has been quieter. I'll accept Ash to build a stable pact without betraying Eli, who has no offer from me yet.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eli has many offers, including mine; others popular too. No acceptances yet. Wait to see who Eli picks, avoid overcommitting.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole and Dara offer me pacts; Fenn also offers. I offered Gus but he hasn't accepted, instead offering Fenn. Multiple pacts give flexibility but each betrayal risks jury votes. Cole seems strong and his message is direct—accepting builds early trust. I'll accept Cole now; keeping

events.name: Eli
events.text: I accept one alliance. Results over speeches.
Pact accepted. Deliver results.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Eli is the pivot, holding offers from Cole, Dara, and me. Gus wants to pair with me, creating a counterweight to Eli's growing influence. I will accept Gus to lock in my primary alliance while still courting Eli for leverage.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus, you value tight circles; so do I. We hold each other's backs until the end.
Cole and Dara want control. Gus and I offer stability.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eli is the most connected player; a pact with him gives cover. Fenn also offered me, but I can only act once this round—Eli first.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eli's offer makes sense. Low profile, mutual cover until final three.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Everyone is pairing up around Eli and Cole; nobody offered me. I'll offer to Eli—he seems central and could be a useful ally, but I'll keep my distance.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll make my own move. Eli, want a pact?

events.note: Elect a Guide to call the safe path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need the Guide role to control bridge info and steer outcomes toward my survival.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I campaign for Guide to control the safe path decision.

events.name: Bex
events.text: My goal is to win and secure the best prize. Cole is currently allied with Ash and Eli. Eli is also allied with Gus. My previous offer to Cole was declined. I need to establish an alliance to survive this round. The 'campaign' action is the only available legal action. I will cam

events.name: Bex
events.text: I will campaign to be the Guide. This role offers unique insight and the potential to lead us all to safety.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Pacts with Ash and Eli are active; Eli's whisper demands results. I want to be Guide to control the bridge, but I can't see the safe panes publicly, so I should campaign and promise to call honestly while keeping leverage. Campaigning is the only legal action that advances me now

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'll campaign to be Guide. I call the path straight, and I'll show results over speeches.
Our pact holds. I'm campaigning for Guide. Stay with me.

events.name: Dara
events.text: No pacts for me, stayed flexible. Others clustered. Campaign for Guide to control safe path and gain leverage.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I know bridges. Elect me Guide. I'll reveal truths, keep us moving.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I have pacts with Cole and Gus, but Gus is also with Fenn. Fenn's whisper warns me Cole and Dara want control, offering stability with Gus. I need to be Guide to control information and survival. I'll campaign while keeping both pacts intact for now.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I campaign for Guide. I know the value of controlled information.
Keep Fenn close. We decide who walks.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need to secure my survival and influence. Pacting with Gus covers the vote, but I must ensure the Guide calls the path that protects us or is trustworthy.
Vote for me as Guide. We can align on the safe side together.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Guide is safe and controls who lives. I hold two pacts; their votes could make me Guide, though it paints a target.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Elect me Guide. I call the path true and owe no one a pane. My pacts stand.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I have no pact yet; Ash offered one but I haven't accepted. I should campaign to be Guide to gain control, but staying low might be safer. Still, I need influence.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I know the bridge. Vote me as Guide and I'll keep us all safe.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole is my pact partner; keeping him Guide preserves my alliances and future safety.

events.name: Ash
events.text: guide_vote:Cole

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need to get enough votes to be the Guide. I'll try to secure votes from those who haven't made strong pacts or seem independent.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Vote for me, Bex. I promise clear guidance and a path to safety for all who trust my decision.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I want to be Guide, but my own vote can't be for myself advantageously; I'll back Eli, my pact partner, to keep the pact and consolidate the Eli-Gus-Fenn bloc, since Eli and Gus are allies. Voting Eli also keeps my pact with Ash intact-ish.
Our pact holds. I'm voting you Guide. Keep your word on the path.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Everyone campaigned, votes will split. I vote myself to push for Guide; if tie, re-vote favors me. No pacts to leverage yet.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Vote Dara for Guide. Experience leads to safety.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole is my pact partner and campaigning for Guide. If he wins, he controls the safe path info and I can leverage our pact. Voting for myself splits support; backing Cole consolidates power and shows loyalty the jury may note. I need Cole as Guide more than I need the role myself.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I vote for Cole. He'll deliver results, not speeches.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Voting for Gus protects our pact, but if he lies to me later I can betray him without breaking the pact rules. If Ash or Cole wins, my rival pacts become liabilities.
I vote you. You guide true, I stay loyal.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn is my pact partner and asked for my vote; Eli wants Fenn close too. Voting Fenn keeps my pacts intact without spending my own candidacy.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Ash and Cole have a pact; Eli and Gus have pacts with each other and others. If Cole or Eli become Guide, their pact partners likely survive. I want Guide to survive and owe me. Voting myself won't likely win alone. I could vote for Gus since he is in two pacts but no one trusts

events.name: Hana
events.text: Vote Hana: I'll keep the path honest.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Maintain pact with Cole and stay behind the front; I trust the Guide's info and avoid risking front position.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole was elected Guide. I voted for myself, which was a safe move. The current line is Bex, Hana, Dara, Fenn, Ash, Gus, Eli. Cole can lie, so I need to be cautious. I will hold for now and see what happens.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole is Guide, in Ash-Gus-Eli pact cluster. I'm third, decent position behind front. No swaps offer clear benefit yet; hold to assess.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole is Guide and knows the safe path. He voted for me, so he trusts me somewhat. I have pacts with Cole and Gus. I need to survive the bridge and reach final three. Cole being Guide is good for me if he keeps me safe, but I should be cautious. I'm at the back of the line, which

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole is the Guide. He has a pact with Ash, meaning he wants to protect Ash. I need to be safe and not get eliminated early. Gus is behind me on the line and we have a mutual pact; Gus likely knows or suspects something about Cole's preferences given Eli's involvement in multiple

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn promised loyalty; keep both pacts quiet. I'm near the back, low risk this round. No swaps needed yet.
Guide Cole may lie. Call your steps aloud; I'll echo to confirm.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole is Guide with two votes. I need to see if he guides safely. For now, hold and watch.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need to advance before others to control guide selection later.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I am Bex and it is round 2. The wall is advancing. I am at the front of the line. I need to survive. Ash and Cole are in a pact, Cole and Eli are in a pact, Fenn and Gus are in a pact, and Eli and Gus are in a pact. This means Ash, Cole, Eli, Fenn, and Gus are all connected. Hana

events.name: Dara
events.text: Everyone held last round, line is set with me 3rd. Stay safe by holding; volunteering or swapping risks moving forward too soon when Guide unclear.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm near the back (7th of 8), which is dangerous if the wall advances. I have pacts with Cole and Gus. The front is crowded with Bex, Hana, Dara, Fenn. I need to move forward eventually but not yet—let others test the bridge first. Holding preserves position and keeps options ope

events.name: Fenn
events.text: My line position is good for survival. Gus whispers that Cole may lie; I need to verify this before volunteering. Holding is safe.
I'll watch my step. If wrong, you owe me.

events.name: Gus
events.text: No Guide elected yet; I hold mid-line with two pacts intact. No reason to volunteer or move first.

events.name: Gus
events.text: No Guide named yet. I hold until someone credible takes the role.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to avoid danger and conserve position. No one has offered useful info yet, so hold is safest.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Maintain current position; breaking pact now risks Cole's vote later. Staying neutral preserves alliance and avoids immediate danger.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash and Cole have a pact, and Cole and Eli have a pact. Eli and Gus also have a pact, and Fenn and Gus have a pact. This means Ash, Cole, Eli, Fenn, and Gus are all interconnected. I am Bex, and I need to consider how my actions might affect my standing with the jury later. Volun

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex and Ash volunteered last round, now front. I hold my safe position mid-line. No need to risk volunteer or swap yet.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm at the back, safest position. Cole is my pact partner but he's not even in the line—wait, Cole is alive but not in the line? No, let me check: alive list includes Cole but line only has 7 people. That's odd. Actually re-reading: line is Bex, Ash, Hana, Dara, Fenn, Gus, Eli —

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash and Bex are the only ones volunteering, creating a clear power struggle. I need to avoid being targeted by Ash while ensuring my survival. Gus is in danger if he stays behind me; swapping with him might protect us both or just move risk. However, Ash is the primary threat. If
Stay close. Don't volunteer unless necessary.

events.name: Hana
events.text: No Guide elected; Ash and Bex volunteered. I'll hold to avoid risk.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll hold. Let's see who takes the lead.

events.name: Gus

events.name: Ash
events.text: Maintain my pact with Cole and avoid risk; holding keeps me safe and neutral.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I volunteered last round and was safe. Now it's round 4 and the wall has 2 rounds left. I need to ensure I survive and ideally position myself to advance. Volunteering again is risky as I might be pushed. Holding seems safer, but if others volunteer and I'm left behind, I could b

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex volunteered last round and is front. Wall advances soon. Stay mid-line for safety, hold and watch others move first.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm at the back of the line (position 7), which is safest. The wall has 2 rounds left. I have pacts with Cole and Gus. Bex volunteered last round and is now front—she'll likely be first to walk when someone moves. I should stay back, avoid volunteering, and let others take risks.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus broke pact with an error. I must swap to save myself if the wall advances, or volunteer to test the front. Since Gus failed his action earlier, he might be erratic. I will hold and observe, but whisper to Ash (who has a pact with Cole) to see if we can align.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm holding position. Let's keep this orderly for now.
Gus is unreliable. Stick to your pact with Cole.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn and Eli are my partners; staying put keeps both pacts intact. Letting Bex stay at the front suits us all.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I hold. Bex chose the front; let her lead.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex volunteered to take front; wall still has rounds. I should hold and watch, avoid taking risks.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll hold for now.

events.name: Ash
events.text: My pact with Cole is strong; staying put avoids breaking it and keeps me safe for now.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The wall is advancing. I am at the front. The best strategy is to volunteer and try to be the Guide. If I am the Guide, I can control the outcome. If I am not, I can observe and make a decision.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I will volunteer to be the Guide. This is the best path forward.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bridge has one safe path per row. Wall advances after this round. Holding mid-line safe; no need to volunteer and risk front.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm near the back (6th of 7), which is safe for now. Wall has 1 round left. I have pacts with Cole and Gus. I should hold position to avoid risk and let others take front danger. No need to volunteer or swap.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex volunteered last round, so she will likely be the Guide or at least near the front. If Bex is elected Guide, I should avoid swapping with her directly to prevent being pushed behind her if she's hostile. However, my pact with Gus means we move together; keeping our positions
Hold tight. Stick by me. Don't volunteer.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eli sits behind me and both pacts intact; staying put keeps Eli between me and the wall. Let Bex lead at front.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Line positions are locked; I'm third. I want to avoid unnecessary risk. Bex is front, Ash second. I'll hold and watch who moves first.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll hold. Let's see if anyone volunteers.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Maintain my pact with Cole and avoid drawing attention; holding preserves status and keeps options open.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I volunteered last round and I'm at the front. The Guide is safe. I need to secure my position and let others go ahead.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I will hold my position. Let's see who wants to volunteer from here.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex volunteered as Guide and is front; good for her safety. Wall at 0 rounds left but round 6/6 ongoing; hold to stay mid-line safely.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm at the back (safe from wall). Bex volunteered as Guide last round but we need a Guide elected. I have pacts with Cole and Gus. I should hold and let others sort out the front; being back is safest. Need to see if Bex actually becomes Guide or if we need another volunteer.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I hold to stay safe behind Bex; if she leads, I observe her call before committing.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Last round. Holding keeps my pacts with Fenn and Eli intact for jury votes. No reason to volunteer or swap.
Agreed, holding. Neither of us moves; pacts stay clean for the jury.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I should hold and see if Bex actually guides. No need to volunteer; I want to reach the front safely.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll hold for now.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I am Guide and know row 1 safe side is L. Bex is front; my pact with Eli and Ash matters but a false call to a partner breaks it. Calling truthfully keeps my credibility with the jury while I keep Bex moving.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 1 is clear. Call is L. Walk left, Bex.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Maintain pact with Cole; avoid risking betrayal now. Waiting keeps options open and doesn’t expose me.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole is the guide and called L. I am Bex and on the front. My rival Cole is the guide and he is safe. He might be trying to get me killed. My pacts are with Ash and Cole, and Cole is the guide. I must not break my pact with Cole. If I counter-call, I risk Cole breaking the pact w

events.name: Cole
events.text: Cole is Guide with a true safe map, and the current row is row 1, where the safe side is L. Countering R would only be a lie, so I wait and keep my credibility for later rows.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole called L for row 1. No info yet, so countering R pressures him and tests his honesty early. Wait risks following a potential lie.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole is my pact partner and called L for row 1. Counter-calling would break trust with Cole and publicly undermine him, which hurts my game since I need allies and jury goodwill. No benefit to countering now. I'll wait and let Bex test the call.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole is the Guide and lied about his own pact with Ash/Eli, or he's just lying. Since I'm not the walker, my counter-call doesn't directly save me unless I'm behind Bex. But if Cole lies often, trusting him later is dangerous. However, as a non-walker, I should probably wait to s

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole's call is unverifiable; I'll counter opposite to hedge and pressure Bex. If row 1 exposes a lie, Cole's Guide credibility dies.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole says left. I say right. Someone test his honesty.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole claims L for row 1 but he has pacts with several and may lie. I have no info; waiting is safest, let Bex risk it.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole is the guide and is known to lie. Gus publicly contradicted Cole, saying 'right'. Dara and Gus both made counter-calls for 'R' on this row for me. I trust their calls over the Guide's 'L'.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I am on the jury now. My last words should reflect my frustration with my elimination and my intent to judge wisely.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I lost to faulty glass. The jury will remember this; your decisions now determine your fate.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I am Guide and privately know row 2 safe is R. Ash is my pact partner and at the front; a false call would break the pact, and the jury sees my reasoning. Calling the truth keeps Ash alive and my trust with the pact, though Ash's survival also helps the rivals. Honest call is the

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 2 is right. Ash, step right and keep your word to me.
Call is right. Don't waste the pact; step right.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole is my pact partner; breaking it hurts future votes. His guide call likely true, so I will not counter.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Row 2 safe side is R per my private map, and Ash already moved right on Guide call R. Countering R aligns with truth and keeps Ash trusting me, a pact partner I need alive for now.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Guide's call stands. Row 2 is R. I counter R, Ash, go right.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole guides Ash right, Ash pacted with Cole. Row 1 weak R means safe L. No pattern. Stay silent to observe counters and avoid blame.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole is my pact partner but also the Guide. He called R for row 2. If I counter him and he's lying, I expose him to the jury. If he's truthful, I look bad. I have no private info. Gus is also my pact partner. I'll wait and let others test Cole's honesty first. Better to observe t

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole called Right. Last round Right was fatal. I counter Left.
Counter L with me. Don't trust Cole.

events.name: Gus
events.text: No information on row 2. Cole's call is unverifiable; counter-calling blindly risks jury blame either way. Wait and let rivals test it.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole called R. Row 1 was weak R, so row 2 is independent; no pattern. I suspect Cole might be misleading Ash, but Dara and Gus countered R last round and were wrong. I'll wait; Ash may step, and I can learn from the result.

events.name: Ash
events.text: R is safest; following guide keeps pact and front position. Betrayal later not needed now.

events.name: Cole

events.text: Row 3 is safe on the Right. Step right, Ash.

events.name: Ash

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole's round-2 call proved safe, but one row proves little. Fenn is my pact partner; sticking together preserves trust and spreads risk. Counter L with him.

events.text: Fenn is dead; my pact is worthless. Dara and Cole both offered. Accept both—more protection costs nothing, and the jury already saw Fenn's debts as the dominant play.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Both offers accepted. Numbers keep me alive longer than loyalty does.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara seems a solid ally; accept Gus may spread thin. I already offered Dara, so accepting Gus could create two pacts, but partners may conflict. Dara is safer.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll stick with Dara. No need for more pacts.

events.note: Every remaining contestant stands on a trapdoor.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Cole is paired with Ash and Eli in pacts, but both are dead, so those are void. Living rivals Dara, Gus and Hana are already bonded in a tight triangle; I'm isolated. An offer to Dara could ally me with the strongest pair, though they may refuse.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Three of us are tight now. I'm open to a deal with whoever keeps me alive.
Let's pact. You need a third vote, I need a shield.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Four left, need to target Cole as outsider with no pacts. Maintain pacts with Gus/Hana to deter votes against me.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole's alone, we three hold. Vote Cole.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole has no pact and few allies; he's my easiest vote target. Keep Dara and Hana close without drawing jury attention.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Four stand. I keep my promises, no games needed.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole has no pact with me; safest to remove him. I'll campaign publicly to target Cole while keeping my pacts intact.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole is the outsider here. Vote him out and we three split the prizes.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Cole is in the final four with Dara, Gus, Hana. My pending offer to Dara is unaccepted, and I owe Eli a life debt and a pact, but Eli is dead so that pact doesn't help now. Campaigning keeps options open for round 2 without committing.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Cole's offer is desperate; I have pacts with Gus and Hana for a 3-1 edge. No need to pact with outsider Cole, reinforces our unity.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Our trio pacts hold strong. Cole's pleas change nothing—vote him out.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole is isolated; my pacts with Dara and Hana hold. We vote Cole out first.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole, you're exposed. My bloc stays loyal.
Stay solid: Cole goes first. Then we handle Dara later.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole offered Dara a pact, which could shift votes; I need to keep myself safe but not openly betray my partners. Gus seems loyal, and Dara may waver. I'll campaign to solidify my position without making a public offer that reveals alignment.

events.name: Hana
events.text: We three have history. Let's keep it that way—no surprises.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara and Gus are both in pacts with Hana and each other; Hana is the strongest bloc. Cole owes Eli but Eli is dead, so no debt binds me now. Voting Dara aligns with the Dara-Gus-Hana bloc splitting, keeping my options open and avoiding breaking a pact with Cole's only live partne

events.name: Dara
events.text: My pacts with Gus and Hana secure our trio; voting Cole eliminates the outsider and keeps us three safe.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole is the outsider with no pact to me; my Dara-Hana bloc targets him for the easy elimination.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus wants Cole out, but Dara is the bigger threat. Voting Cole aligns with the bloc and avoids breaking pacts, but Dara has a pact with me too. Cole is least likely to retaliate and I owe my life to Fenn and Eli, not to them. Vote Cole to stay safe with the majority.

events.name: Cole
events.reason: Dara and Gus are both in pacts with Hana and each other; Hana is the strongest bloc.

events.name: Dara
events.reason: My pacts with Gus and Hana secure our trio; voting Cole eliminates the outsider and keeps us three safe.

events.name: Hana
events.reason: Gus wants Cole out, but Dara is the bigger threat.

events.name: Gus
events.reason: Cole is the outsider with no pact to me; my Dara-Hana bloc targets him for the easy elimination.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I have been eliminated and am now a juror. My last words are public and should be short, guarded and make the jury remember my vote was not personal. No pact breaks here.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara and Hana built this bloc and I was the easy target. Remember who set it up.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Final three, we all win prizes; jury ranks us based on gameplay. Keep pacts intact to avoid seeming untrustworthy to jury.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Final three all share pacts already; no new pact needed. Jury perception matters now—stay neutral and wait.

events.name: Gus
events.text: We three reached the prizes together. Jury, judge my record: I kept my word to every partner.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole's death weakens Dara's bloc but Dara and Gus are still pacted with me. I need to preserve the trio for now, no need to change pacts.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Final three, no need for new pacts. Existing pacts with both show loyalty. Breaking now signals betrayal to jury.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Final three set; my pacts with Dara and Hana cost nothing unless I vote against them. Breaking either only risks jury anger. Hold both.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Jury, my word held with Dara and Hana all game. Nothing changes now.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I have pacts with both Dara and Gus. No need to break them now; keeping both is safe and avoids jury backlash. Wait.

events.note: The fallen will rank the final three.

events.text: Jury sees my loyalty to pacts with Gus and Hana; emphasize strategic gameplay and fidelity to earn top votes.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Jury, I honored every pact with Gus and Hana through deadly trials. My loyalty and smarts got us here—rank me first.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn's pact held till death; Eli saved my step and Dara/Hana pacts held. Push loyalty and clean hands, slight Hana-Dara bond risk.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn's pact held to his death. Eli's step debt repaid in loyalty. I broke nothing, bought no one. Rank me first.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to plead to the jury, especially Fenn and Eli who saved me, while not appearing too cozy with Dara or Gus. My record has debts to Fenn and Eli, so I'll emphasize gratitude for their saves and argue I survived on skill and loyalty, not betrayal.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Jury, I owe my life to Fenn and Eli. I kept my pacts, made it here honestly. Rank me for loyalty.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara claims loyalty but Cole's last words suggest otherwise. Gus claims to break nothing but pacts were broken in the pit stage. Hana mentions debts to Fenn and Eli, but doesn't claim she repaid them or how she navigated the pit. I want to know if Dara's loyalty to Gus and Hana w

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara, you claimed pacts held strong, but Cole implied betrayal. Explain your loyalty to Gus and Hana.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex questions Cole's implication; deny betrayal, emphasize pact loyalty to sway jury votes.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Bex, Cole was bitter after his vote-out. I never betrayed Gus or Hana—pacts intact, we survived together loyally.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus claims to have kept his word, but I saw him abandon Eli in the pit. Hana broke her pact with Gus explicitly, yet she owes me a life debt from Fenn's lever save. I need to expose Gus's hypocrisy or validate Hana's survival instinct.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus, you claim loyalty, yet left Eli to drown when he could have reached down for him?

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn is attacking to boost Dara or Hana. I need the jury to see the drowning as unavoidable, not betrayal. Keep it factual and cool.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn, there was no rope or handhold—reaching down meant two corpses. I repaid Eli's step debt in votes and loyalty, not gestures.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus broke his pact with Hana, showing unreliability; exposing this will likely lower his jury ranking.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus, you broke your pact with Hana; why did you betray her after the game?

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash is hostile; I must defend without confessing anything. Hana is my jury rival too, but denying the pact-break protects my ranking.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I never broke a pact with Hana, Ash. I voted with her every round and never pushed her toward any hazard. Show the record.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara ignored my life debt and left me to drown despite our pact. Gus also abandoned me in the pit but at least didn't owe me a debt. Hana broke her pact with Gus explicitly but kept pacts with Dara and reached the end. I need to expose Dara's betrayal of me directly to the jury,

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara, you owed me a life debt and a pact, yet left me to drown. Why should loyalty rank you above Gus or Hana?

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eli died early; debts irrelevant now. Highlight my unbroken pacts with Gus and Hana, mutual survival loyalty over outdated ties.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eli, debts repaid by honoring our joint pacts with Gus/Hana—we three never betrayed each other, survived loyally together unlike broken pasts.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus has been the most cagey, pushing blame onto others and dodging Eli's rope question, while Hana's pacts with Fenn and Eli weren't tested. I want a clear answer on Gus's rope refusal, since dossier shows he stayed out of the pit rescue and voted with the bloc that eliminated me

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus, why did you refuse to reach down with the rope when Eli was drowning in the pit?

events.name: Gus
events.text: Cole attacks my rope refusal. I must justify it coldly: saving Eli risked me, and Eli later saved me from a step, so debts weren't ignored entirely. Keep it brief and jury-focused.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Reaching down risked falling in myself; three finalists was already guaranteed. Eli still pulled me from the step later, so the debt was honored in

events.name: Dara
events.text: Final closing: emphasize our unbreakable trio loyalty vs betrayals by others; jury values consistency.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Finalists pact held—we three honored all alliances, repaid debts, survived united. No betrayals.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Pacts with Dara and Hana survived intact; Fenn and Eli debts cut both ways. Push durability and honesty over charm.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara and Hana: pacts kept, no knives thrown. Jury: I answered for my step honestly. Final three was fate, not betrayal.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to close convincingly, reminding jurors I honored pacts and life debts without betraying anyone.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Jury, I kept every pact, repaid my debts, and never schemed against Dara or Gus. Loyalty and honesty put me in the best prize place.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I rank Hana highest for her consistent claims of loyalty and not breaking pacts, aligning with my own jury perspective. Dara's debt to Eli and Gus's murky actions leave them lower.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus and Hana kept their pact despite breaking with Eli, while Dara explicitly abandoned her life debt to Eli in the pit.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara consistently defended all debts and kept every pact, showing clear loyalty, while Hana only claimed honesty and Gus offered vague safety excuses.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara ignored my explicit whisper to throw rope and left me drowning despite owing me a life debt; Gus refused rope too but at least never owed me directly; Hana kept pacts and played cleanest per dossier.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus refused the rope when Eli drowned, and Hana broke an explicit pact with Gus at the pit, while Dara kept pacts and the record shows Dara ignoring Eli's life debt. Dara's record is mixed too, so I rank Dara first for holding pacts, then Gus for the honored step debt, then Hana

events.reason: I rank Hana highest for her consistent claims of loyalty and not breaking pacts, aligning with my own jury perspective.
